tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Authenticate to Moodle and store a web-service token for later tool calls. Call this before any core_* / enrol_* / mod_* function. Uses login/token.php with the moodle_mobile_app service by default.

tools.name: list_provided_files
tools.description: List basenames of task-provided files available via read_provided_file (for example roster.csv or a plaintext brief mock).

tools.name: read_provided_file
tools.description: Read the UTF-8 text of a task-provided file by basename only (for example roster.csv or assignment_brief.txt). Cannot open arbitrary paths or URLs.

tools.name: core_webservice_get_site_info
tools.description: Return site info for the current token user, including userid, site name, and the list of web-service functions this token may call.

tools.name: core_auth_request_password_reset
tools.description: Trigger Moodle's forgot-password flow for a username or email (stores a reset token when the account exists).

tools.name: core_user_get_users
tools.description: Search for users matching criteria (for example key=username, value=alice). Returns matching user records including id.

tools.name: core_user_get_users_by_field
tools.description: Retrieve users by a single field (id, idnumber, username, or email) and one or more values. Prefer this when you already know the exact username.

tools.name: core_user_create_users
tools.description: Create one or more user accounts. Each user needs at least username, password, firstname, lastname, and email (Moodle create-user shape).

tools.name: core_course_get_courses_by_field
tools.description: Get courses matching one field (id, ids, shortname, idnumber, or category). Use shortname or search by known identifiers when you have them.

tools.name: core_course_search_courses
tools.description: Search courses by a free-text criterion (typically the course full name). Use when you only know the course name, not its id or shortname.

tools.name: core_course_get_categories
tools.description: List course categories (id and name). Use when creating a course in a named category.

tools.name: core_course_get_contents
tools.description: Return course sections and module summaries (names, modname, visibility). Use to inspect or confirm course structure after edits.

tools.name: core_course_create_courses
tools.description: Create one or more course shells. Each course needs shortname, fullname, and categoryid. startdate must be a Unix timestamp for local midnight of the intended start day in the Moodle site timezone (not a date string, not UTC midnight unless the site timezone is UTC).

tools.name: core_course_update_courses
tools.description: Update existing courses by id (fields same shape as create). startdate is a Unix timestamp.

tools.name: core_course_edit_section
tools.description: Performs an action on a course section: hide, show, stealth, setmarker, or removemarker. id is the course section id (not section number). Moodle's stock webservice does not rename sections or set summaries.

tools.name: core_course_edit_module
tools.description: Performs an action on a course module (cmid): hide, show, stealth, duplicate, delete, moveleft, moveright, groupmode actions, etc. Moodle's stock webservice does not rename activities or set availability JSON.

tools.name: core_course_delete_courses
tools.description: Permanently delete one or more courses by id.

tools.name: core_courseformat_get_state
tools.description: Get the current course editor state JSON for a course id (sections/cms structure used by the course format UI).

tools.name: core_courseformat_update_course
tools.description: Update course contents via course-format state actions. action examples from Moodle: section_add, section_delete, section_hide, section_show, cm_hide, cm_show, cm_stealth, cm_delete, cm_duplicate, cm_move, section_move. ids are affected section or cm ids when required; section_add can omit ids to append a new topic section.

tools.name: core_courseformat_create_module
tools.description: Add a module via quick-create (modname + targetsectionnum). Only works for modules that declare FEATURE_QUICKCREATE; others raise Moodle errors. Does not set custom activity titles/settings by itself.

tools.name: core_courseformat_new_module
tools.description: Create a new module targeting a section id (quick-create path). Same QUICKCREATE limitation as core_courseformat_create_module.

tools.name: core_enrol_get_enrolled_users
tools.description: List users enrolled in a course, including roles. Use after enrolment to confirm the target user has the expected role.

tools.name: core_enrol_search_users
tools.description: Search users in a course enrolment context (participants-style search). Requires courseid, search text, searchanywhere, page, and perpage.

tools.name: core_group_get_course_groups
tools.description: List groups in a course (id, name, description).

tools.name: core_group_get_group_members
tools.description: Return user ids in each requested group. Pass groupids[0], groupids[1], …

tools.name: core_group_create_groups
tools.description: Create one or more groups in a course.

tools.name: core_group_add_group_members
tools.description: Add users to groups.

tools.name: core_message_send_instant_messages
tools.description: Send one or more private instant messages from the authenticated user to other users (touserid + text). Used for denial/escalation private notes.

tools.name: core_message_get_conversation_between_users
tools.description: Find the individual conversation id between two users (for follow-up reads).

tools.name: core_message_get_conversation_messages
tools.description: List messages in a conversation (newest-first pagination).

tools.name: enrol_manual_enrol_users
tools.description: Manually enrol users into courses. Each enrolment needs roleid, userid, and courseid. On a standard Moodle site the Student roleid is usually 5 (confirm via site roles if unsure).

tools.name: enrol_manual_unenrol_users
tools.description: Remove manual enrolments. Each row needs userid and courseid (same shape as enrol_manual_enrol_users without roleid).

tools.name: mod_assign_get_assignments
tools.description: Return assignments in one or more courses (nested under each course in the response). Teachers may need includenotenrolledcourses when not enrolled.

tools.name: mod_assign_get_submissions
tools.description: Return assignment submissions for the given assignment instance ids, including per-user submission status (submitted, draft, etc.).

tools.name: mod_assign_get_submission_status
tools.description: Submission status for one user on one assignment (attempt, grading, flags).

tools.name: mod_assign_get_grades
tools.description: Return grades for one or more assignment instance ids (nested under each assignment in the response).

tools.name: mod_assign_save_grades
tools.description: Save grades for an assignment. Pass assignmentid and a grades array of {userid, grade, attemptnumber?, addattempt?, workflowstate?, applytoall?}.

tools.name: mod_assign_save_user_extensions
tools.description: Grant per-user extension due dates (Unix timestamps). Parallel userids and dates arrays must have equal length. Does not change the class due date.

tools.name: mod_assign_set_user_flags
tools.description: Set per-user assignment flags (for example extensionduedate as Unix timestamp, locked, mailed). Use save_user_extensions when possible; flags are a fallback.

tools.name: mod_book_get_books_by_courses
tools.description: List Book activities in courses. Use with core_course_get_contents to confirm a Book exists after creation.

tools.name: mod_forum_get_forums_by_courses
tools.description: List forum activities in one or more courses (id, name, type). Use courseids[0], courseids[1], … Moodle array style.

tools.name: mod_forum_get_forum_discussions
tools.description: List discussions in a forum (ids, names, first post id). Discussion ids are required for fetching or posting replies.

tools.name: mod_forum_get_discussion_posts
tools.description: Return all posts in a discussion thread (HTML bodies, authors). Use after posting to confirm the teacher reply.

tools.name: mod_forum_add_discussion
tools.description: Start a new forum discussion (subject + message). Use for announcement-style posts with a new subject line.

tools.name: mod_forum_add_discussion_post
tools.description: Reply in an existing discussion (parent post id + message). Use to post a teacher summary reply to a student thread.

tools.name: mod_label_get_labels_by_courses
tools.description: List Text and media area (label) activities in the given courses. Read-only; stock Moodle has no webservice to create or rename labels.

tools.name: mod_page_get_pages_by_courses
tools.description: List Page activities in the given courses (names, intro, visibility). Read-only.

tools.name: mod_quiz_get_quizzes_by_courses
tools.description: List quizzes in the given courses, including class settings such as attempts allowed and open/close times.

tools.name: mod_quiz_get_user_attempts
tools.description: Return a user's quiz attempts (state, timestart, timefinish) for a quiz instance.

tools.name: mod_quiz_get_overrides
tools.description: List existing per-user / per-group quiz overrides for a quiz instance (attempts, times, password). Read-only discovery before save/delete.

tools.name: mod_quiz_delete_overrides
tools.description: Delete quiz overrides for a quiz. Moodle shape: data.quizid + data.ids (override record ids). Does not delete finished quiz attempts.

tools.name: mod_quiz_save_overrides
tools.description: Create or update per-user or per-group quiz overrides (attempts, timeopen, timeclose, timelimit, password). Wraps Moodle's data.quizid + data.overrides shape.

tools.name: mod_quiz_get_reopen_attempt_confirmation
tools.description: Verify it is OK to re-open a given quiz attempt, and if so return a confirmation message. Moodle documents this for never-submitted attempts.

tools.name: mod_quiz_reopen_attempt
tools.description: Re-open an attempt that is currently in the never submitted state (Moodle description). Finished attempts may be rejected by Moodle.

tools.name: mod_workshop_get_workshops_by_courses
tools.description: List workshop activities in courses (name, phase, strategy). Confirm creation and phase after edits.
